description: Single storey rear extension and external alterations involving new replacement front door and first floor rear window.
decision_conditions: All new external works and finishes, and any works of making good, shall match the existing original fabric in respect of using materials of a matching materiality, dimensions, colour, texture, detailed execution and finished appearance, except where indicated otherwise on the drawings hereby approved. Reason: To ensure the external appearance of the development preserves the character and appearance of the host dwelling and the Conservation Area in accordance with Policy DMD44 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014) and Core Policy 31 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010).

Prior to the commencement of works above ground level, additional drawings by section and elevation at scales of between 1:20 and 1:1 as appropriate shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. These shall show details of proposed new: Windows (including cills, lintels, reveals, ironmongery and methodology of 'making good' brickwork around new or altered apertures) Front door (including ironmongery) Notwithstanding approved drawing W201.21 dated November 2025, all glazing to the new front door shall match the existing in all respects. Works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such. Reason: To ensure the detailed design and materials preserve the character and appearance of the host dwelling and the Conservation Area in accordance with Policy DMD44 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014), Core Policy 31 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Section 72 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
